name: SWE state arrows
purpose: Shared source assets for future state indicators; not yet wired into any client.

generator.status: Original export script preserved as source reference, not a project build step.
generator.portability: Requires adapting its original /workspace paths and Linux font path before running locally.

usage.accessibility: Pair state arrows with a text label or accessible description; do not convey state through color alone.
usage.pixel_scaling: Use integer scaling and nearest-neighbor interpolation for pixel assets.
usage.client_integration: Copy selected assets into each client's resources when adopting them; this directory is not a runtime bundle.
